row.proto: float Ai_QualiPace_CalcSegmentTime(void *self, uint8_t vehicle_id, uint32_t tyre, float start, float end, float mass, uint32_t a7)
row.notes: Returns 0 if tyre >= 5. Else maps tyre (self+0x31c set and tyre <= 2 -> 0), mass' = mass + self+0x318; lazily computes a pace value self+0x3a4 (when < 0) from clamp(self+0x314, 0, 100) via Sess_VirtualSession_EstimateLapTime 0x142f6c8e0 (vehicle self+0x3b, per-car tables self+0xa8/+0xac, car data from 0x146ce86e0) and Sess_VirtualPerformance_CalcPace 0x1438a9d10. Then calls the lap model self+0x228 vcall +0x150 twice, (vehicle, start) and (vehicle, end), with a param block {tyre in 3..4 flag, value from model rec +0x1c, a7, mass', pace}; logs QUALI_PACE_DEBUG 'vehicleId %d, tyre %d, start %f, end %f, mass %f, tyreType %d, timeStart %f, timeEnd %f'; returns timeEnd - timeStart. Callers: 0x14297ed10, 0x14297fc20 (4x), 0x142982500, Game_TrackAcclimatisation_CalcTyreTarget. (renamed 2026-11-14 to the name signatures.json already listed; from Ai_QualiPace_Debug: the code contradicts the old name) L2 2026-11-14 (engine-re AI round): decomp read and claims checked against the disassembly; references from a full rel32/riprel/abs64 scan of .xtls/.xtext/.data1. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-14 at user request (lane owner review requested) Returns timeEnd - timeStart (vsubss at 0x1429809f5), so it is a segment time, not a lap time: renamed from Ai_QualiPace_EstimateLapTime (fixed 2026-11-14 after verifier ai-verify).
